request.query: polynomial weighted vanishing index rational points coefficient height bound

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.nat_le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_notMem
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq M] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∀ i ∉ Finset.image (⇑(Finsupp.weight w)) φ.support, (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w i) φ = 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} (n : M)
  (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) [inst_2 : DecidableEq M] (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d ((MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) φ) =
    if (Finsupp.weight w) d = n then MvPolynomial.coeff d φ else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} (n : M)
  (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (∀ d ∈ φ.support, (Finsupp.weight w) d ≠ n) → (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) φ = 0
